roa.docketEntryComment: DEFT'S PC1473,7 MOTION WITHDRAW GUILTY PLEA, P & A FILED

/CAL  MOTION TO VACATE PURSUANT TO PC1473,7; DA NON-OPP TO SET ASIDE/X  DFENSE ATTORNEY MICHAEL POOLE MAKING A GENERAL APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OFTHE DEFENDANT/X: THE PEOPLE DO NOT OPPOSE PETITIONER'S MOTION TO SET ASIDE THE GUILTY PLEA, ENTER A NOT GUILTY PLEA AND SET ASIDE THE CONVICTION AND SENTENCE OF NOVEMBER 5TH, 1998/MO GRTD/X: PLEA DATE:11-05-1998/X: SENTENCE DATE:11-05-1998/ /X: THE COURT FINDS DEFENDANT WAS NOT PROPERLY ADVISED OF THEPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCES OF A GUILTY PLEA, /CTORD: THE CONVICTION AND SENTENCE WERE ILLEGAL AND INVALID,  PREJUDICIAL ERROR DAMAGED THE DEFENDANT,  ACCORDINGLY, THE GUILTY PLEA ENTERED ON 11-05-1998 IS SET ASIDE A NOT GUILTYPLEA IS ENTERED, THE SENTENCE ENTERED ON 11-05-1998 ARE HEREBY VACATED, /X: THERE BEING NO NEW PLEA ENTERED, THE COURT ORDERS THE MATTER DISMISSED/MO PC 1385: INTEREST OF JUSTICE/X: ORDER SIGNED AND FILED/
